nodes.label: Incremental EPUB Resource Reads
nodes.rationale: Reopening the EPUB through a direct ZIP adapter separates payload-free declaration facts from bounded incremental payload access and avoids eager buffering or maintaining a crate fork.

nodes.label: Retained EPUB Declarations
nodes.rationale: Retaining declarations once provides a consistent authoritative run snapshot and avoids repeated EPUB parsing or observing declaration changes mid-run.

nodes.label: Modular Document Processing
nodes.rationale: Separating DOCX, EPUB, and shared image utilities was recommended to keep document-specific processing organized.

nodes.label: Incremental Image Processing
nodes.rationale: Processing one image at a time mitigates memory use for large EPUB archives.
